name: ai-code-review
description: LLM-powered code review and security analysis of your git changes, using your Copilot models.

chatParticipants.name: aireview
chatParticipants.description: Review changed files and propose inline fixes

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review changed files and propose fixes (arg: staged | <branch>)

commands.name: security
commands.description: Security-check changed files and propose fixes (arg: staged | <branch>)

enumDescriptions: Use the Claude Code CLI (claude -p). Needs Claude Code installed and signed in; no Copilot quota used.
Use the VSCode Language Model API (GitHub Copilot models).
aiReview.backend.description: Model backend for review, security, and docs. Switch to vscode-lm to use Copilot.

aiReview.claudeCodePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI executable (used when backend is claude-code).

aiReview.claudeCodeModel.description: Model passed to the Claude Code CLI as --model. Leave empty for the CLI default.

aiReview.modelFamily.description: Preferred Copilot model family (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3.5-sonnet), used when backend is vscode-lm. Leave empty to auto-select.

aiReview.maxInputChars.description: Maximum number of diff or code characters sent to the model. Larger inputs are truncated to stay within context limits.

aiReview.reviewPersona.description: Default reviewer standard for code review and security check. Use a preset key (senior-engineer, coding-agent, pragmatic, strict) or type a custom standard sentence. You can still change it per run.
